title: Critical Splash Screens
description: Displays a per-character static screen overlay (with optional sound) on natural 20 crits (or a lowered crit threshold, auto-detected or manually overridden) and natural 1 fumbles (attacks, death saves, ability checks, skill checks) for dnd5e, via Sequencer, and plays a random death sound when a token dies. Universal crit/fumble sound folders act as fallbacks for characters with no custom sound; image and sound play independently, so a sound still plays even with no custom image set. GM-client-only to avoid duplicate/overlapping sounds across connected players. Configurable through Module Settings.
